final_text: The design was buggy in two ways: `duty_q` latched one cycle too late (`cnt == 0` instead of `cnt == 255`, the wrap edge), and `pwm_out` used `cnt <= duty_q` instead of `cnt < duty_q`, producing one extra high cycle. Both are fixed in `rtl/pwm.v`, and the testbench now reports **TEST PASSED** with no errors.
